Data policy: no fabricated proxies. Official public sources provide the primary foundation for United Kingdom; native statistical and central bank releases are prioritized where available. 数据原则：不制造 proxy。官方公开来源提供英国的基础数据；优先接入本国统计局与央行的原生发布序列。

National Accounts & GDP Tracking国民账户与GDP跟踪

The GS UK guide stresses that early GDP releases are heavily revised. Use official GDP, demand components, and real-time trackers together rather than treating first GDP as the final word.GS英国统计指南强调，早期GDP发布会经历较大修订。应把官方GDP、需求分项与实时跟踪指标结合使用，而不是把初值视为最终答案。
